rename.to: [NEXT-1229] Error with `cookies.set()` in server actions on edge runtime : `Error: Invariant: Method expects to have requestAsyncStorage, none available`

body: I am using default nodejs runtime, it works when I just run `npm run dev` in my local, but after I changing something inside the server action (even just add some spaces), it throws this error, then if I stop and rerun the project, it works again.. is it a bug?
I believe this issue #50658 is also related, where `getServerSession` (from `next-auth`) is using `cookie()` internally.

issue.title: Force Dynamic Rendering for database queries
issue.body:
This PR update the `connectOneTimeToDatabase()` function in order to call `headers()` in every call of the sql client. This will prevent Next.js wrongly flag some pages using database queries as static content.

A new [feature request was created](https://github.com/vercel/next.js/discussions/50695#discussion-5258288) to not need to call headers in every sql query

issue.title: Fix shared layer bundling in Edge Runtime
issue.body:
Our shared layer matcher doesn't contain `next/dist/esm`, which breaks Server Actions when there're cookie/header accesses.

Closes #50099. Fix NEXT-1229
